key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.98s): Initial archival pose of hospital; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=5.11s): Mid-sequence articulation of hospital; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=6.34s): Peak dynamic extension of hospital over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.58s): Follow-through and settle of hospital with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of hospital (3.98s..7.58s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
